note: Every vscode.window.showInformationMessage/showWarningMessage call under src/ that offers MORE THAN ONE button must either be converted to a WorkflowDecisionV1/StructuredQuestionV1 posted in the chat, or be listed here with a reason it genuinely is NOT a workflow decision (task 'stage chat as a record of work', item 13 / Part 12 step 35e). A single-button call never needs an entry — the lint only flags calls that ask the user to choose between options. Entries are keyed by file:line, so a line-number drift on an untouched call is expected to surface as a stale entry on the next run — update the line, do not delete the entry, unless the call itself was removed or reduced to one button.

directActionEntriesNote: Every NotificationRouter.show(Information/Warning/Error) call under src/ whose actionCommand dispatches a workflow command directly (rather than the chat-pointer vs-code-ai-helper.openWorkflowDecision) must either be converted to point at a WorkflowDecisionV1 in the chat, or be listed here with a reason it is NOT a hidden workflow decision (task 'stage chat as a record of work', item 13 / Part 12 step 35e, review round 2). Two shapes qualify: (1) a synchronous gate/nudge inline in the user-invoked command it belongs to, pointing at a command already reachable another way (Command Palette, another button) and never the only record of a background round's outcome; (2) a best-effort fallback for when a WorkflowDecisionV1 could not be posted to chat (no activating extension context), degrading to a single pointer at the same option the decision would have recommended.
